rock.title: Rock in Rio 2026.
rock.lead: Leitura Delas and O Papo que Protege at Espaço Plural.
rock.delivery: We built digital experiences connecting kiosks, mobile phones and a live screen. Delivered for Rock World with Casa Brasil and Educa Brasis, exploring women’s stories and respectful relationships.
rock.alt: Visitors and the activation space at Espaço Plural, Rock in Rio
rock.caption: Espaço Plural · Rock in Rio 2026 · project archive

circuito.title: Circuito Musical das Águas.
circuito.delivery: We produced a free concert circuit across seven cities in Rio de Janeiro, sponsored by Setur-RJ. From curation to production and operations, we connected artists, audiences and communities.
circuito.alt: Pique Novo performing at Circuito Musical das Águas in São Pedro da Aldeia
circuito.caption: Pique Novo · São Pedro da Aldeia · photo: Cleydson Alan/PMSPA

qbanho.title: QBANHO + Equatorial.
qbanho.lead: A technology that found its market.
qbanho.delivery: We connected QBANHO with Equatorial and led the commercial engagement to introduce heat exchangers into the group’s solutions portfolio. Turning strategy and relationships into business.
qbanho.alt: QBANHO +30 floor-mounted heat exchanger platform in neutral tones
qbanho.caption: QBANHO +30 heat exchanger · stylized image
